Positioned within easy reach of the university campus and local amenities, this property benefits from excellent transport links including regular bus services and is conveniently located next to Five Ways train station. The city centre is reachable in under 15 minutes.

This spacious en-suite room measures around 14sqm and is located on the first floor. It comfortably accommodates a double bed with under-bed storage, a drawer unit, wardrobe, desk, and chair. One bedroom benefits from an en-suite shower room.

Each cluster flat comprises six en-suite rooms sharing a large, open-plan kitchen, dining, and living space. A fully equipped kitchen includes two fridge-freezers, a dishwasher, washer-dryer, oven, ceramic hob, microwave, kettle, and toaster. A large flat-screen TV is provided in the communal living area.

This well-maintained property features a digital entry system and CCTV for enhanced security. Super-fast Wi-Fi is available throughout the building.

Where bills are included: Gas, electricity, water, TV licence, fibre broadband where possible (limited by a fair usage policy).
